description: This file defines a React component for managing a list of companies, including fetching existing companies, displaying them in a table, and providing a form to create new companies. It relies on custom UI components and API calls to interact with backend services.

methods.name: CompaniesPage
methods.description: Main React component rendering the companies management interface, including fetch, display, and create functionalities.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches the list of companies from the API and updates state.

methods.name: createCompany
methods.description: Handles the form submission for creating a new company and refreshes the company list.
